headline: Public hearing on Boston Gas gas mains at 217-250 Westford Street; purchase of Senior Center at 276 Broadway Street.
summary: The agenda includes utility requests for gas mains, electric conduit, and fiber optic conduit. It also includes a vote to authorize purchase of the Senior Center at 276 Broadway Street, plus motions and reports on city matters.
items: Remote participation rules for the public
Proclamation for Lung Cancer Awareness
Release of executive session minutes from October 6, 2026 (Flock Cameras)
Public hearing: Boston Gas request to replace gas mains at 217-250 Westford Street and parts of Lane and Fernald Streets
Public hearing: National Grid request to install underground electric conduit along Robeson Street for service at 225 Middlesex Street
Zayo Enterprise Networks request to install underground fiber optic conduit at 174 South Street
Motion: City Manager to work with Parks and Recreation on the future outlook of the Summer Youth Program
Motion: City Manager to update on feedback regarding the Specialized Building Code
Motion: City Manager to present a fire station repair update to the Public Safety Subcommittee
Motion: City Clerk to prepare LHA TIF executive session minutes for review
Motion: City Manager to provide an updated replanting plan in Centralville
Motion: report on enforcement of approval conditions for the Apple Orchard Project and permit compliance
Motion: explore adopting the residential tax exemption and the Good Landlord Tax Abatement together
Motion: Finance Subcommittee and city finance team to meet as needed for the FY28 budget process
Motion: executive session to review and approve executive session minutes and set a release timeline

City Manager motion responses: Westford and Stedman Streets; South Loring and Shaw; Princeton and Baldwin; Mt Pleasant and 1st; Lawrence and Billerica; Gorham and Manchester; Elm and Chapel; Pine and Georgia; alcohol bar license
Communication on reappointments to various boards and commissions
City Manager request for one out-of-state travel for the Police Department (DPD)
Vote: authorize amendment to the ACRE Urban Renewal Plan for 276 Broadway Street
Vote: authorize purchase of the Senior Center at 276 Broadway Street
Vote: confirm executive session votes for Draper Laboratory
Claim for property damage (3)
Request from David Trainor to address the City Council regarding Flock Cameras
Request from Ourn Chak for a handicap parking sign at 57 Ware Street
Request from William J. McAllister for a handicap parking sign at 105 Jewett St.
location: City Council Chamber, 375 Merrimack Street, 2nd Floor, Lowell, MA / Zoom (Hybrid)

C. Nuon - Req. City Mgr. Collaborate With Parks And Recreation To Brief The City 
Council On The Future Outlook Of The Summer Youth Program.
C. Nuon - Req. City Mgr. Direct The Appropriate Department To Update The City 
Council On The Status Of The Public And Sustainability Council Feedback Regarding 
The Specialized Building Code.
C. Nuon - Req. City Mgr. Coordinate With The Relevant Department To Present A Fire 
Station Repair Update To The Public Safety Subcommittee.
C. Nuon - Req. City Clerk Prepare The Executive Session Minutes Regarding The 
LHA TIF For The City Council And The Solicitor Review Ahead Of Their Release.
C. Robinson - Req. City Mgr. Provide An Updated Replanting Plan Complete With 
Locations And Tree Types In Centralville. (Woodward And Curran Original Plan).
C. Robinson - Req City Mgr. Have The Proper Department Provide A Report On What 
Is Being Done To Enforce The Approval Conditions Of The Apple Orchard Project As 
Well As How Occupancy Permits And All Other Permitting Continues Without Being In 
Compliance.
C. McDonough - Req. The City Mgr. Work With The Appropriate Department To 
Explore The Implications Of Adopting The Residential Tax Exemption (M.G.L. C. 59, 
S. 5C ) And The 'Good Landlord Tax Abatement' (M.G.L. C. 59, S. 5O) Simultaneously 
To Ensure That Working Families Are Taxed Fairly While Maintaining City Revenue 
And Protecting Naturally Occurring Affordable Housing. 
C. Juran - Req. Finance SC And City Finance Team Meet As Needed To Prepare For 
FY28 Budget Process, To Ensure Coordination And Communication Between City 
Council And City Administration.
C. Juran - Req. City Council To Go Into Executive Session To (A) Review Unreleased 
Executive Session Minutes, (B) Approve Final Minutes, (C) Determine Which 
Portions, If Any, Of Such Approved Minutes Are Ready For Release, And (D) Agree 
On A Timeline For Ongoing Review Of Minutes And Determination Of Portion Which, If 
Any, Minutes Should Be Released.
